title: Technical supply conditions for reciprocating air compressors for power upto 25 kW for general purpose and industrial applications
clause_1_scope: 1. Scope — This standard applies to single acting trunk type piston reciprocating air compressors for the general purpose industrial applications having horse power up to 25 kW meant for intermittent duty (2 000 operating hours per year) applications.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Testing of Positive Displacement Type Air Compressors and Exhausters - Code of Practice
Power Transmission - Bush Type Flexible Coupling

clause_3_terminology: Technical supply conditions for reciprocating air compressors for power upto 25 kW for general purpose and industrial applications

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
